s: What does "Moturpha" refer to?
x:
Moturpha was a professional tax imposed on artisans and craftsmen, particularly on weavers and their looms. It was one of the important taxes collected during the colonial period and was strongly opposed by the weaving community because it increased their economic burden.
Hence, the correct answer is
Option (3).
